# README.md

Source: https://github.com/livehelperchat/livehelperchat/blob/master/README.md

Live helper chat
==============

It's an open-source powered application that brings simplicity and usability into one place. With Live Helper Chat, you can bring live support to your site for free. http://livehelperchat.com. In a production environment, serving clients handling over [10,000](https://doc.livehelperchat.com/docs/performance) chats per day with dozens of operators actively working.  




## Need help?
* Documentation - https://doc.livehelperchat.com
* Forum/Discussions - https://github.com/LiveHelperChat/livehelperchat/discussions
* Chat (Discord) https://discord.gg/YsZXQVh
* [Laravel version of Live Helper Chat](https://github.com/LiveHelperChat/livehelperchat_laravel)

## Quick install guide

### By cloning repository

If you clone git repository you have to install composer dependencies. Min 8.2 PHP version.

```
cd lhc_web && composer install
```

Now you can just enter in your browser `lhc_web/index.php`

### By downloading from release section

Navigate to https://github.com/LiveHelperChat/livehelperchat/releases and download most recent relese.

You do not need to install composer dependencies in that scenario.

For alternative install ways read https://doc.livehelperchat.com/docs/install

## Demo

http://livehelperchat.com/demo-12c.html 

Demo with ChatGPT and streaming support can be found at https://doc.livehelperchat.com/ Try to ask a question about Live Helper Chat. ChatGPT install instructions [here](https://github.com/LiveHelperChat/chatGPT/)

## Quick development guide
 * After the app is installed, disable cache and enable debug output.
   * https://github.com/LiveHelperChat/livehelperchat/blob/master/lhc_web/settings/settings.ini.default.php#L13-L16
   * Change the following values to:
    ```
    * debug_output => true
   * templatecache => false
   * templatecompile => false
   * modulecompile => false
   ```
 * To compile JS from lhc_web folder execute. This will compile main JS and old widget javascript files.
   * `npm install && gulp`
 * To compile new widget V2
   * There is two apps [wrapper](https://github.com/LiveHelperChat/livehelperchat/tree/master/lhc_web/design/defaulttheme/widget/wrapper) and [widget](https://github.com/LiveHelperChat/livehelperchat/tree/master/lhc_web/design/defaulttheme/widget/react-app)
   * `cd lhc_web/design/defaulttheme/widget/wrapper && npm install && npm run build`
   * `cd lhc_web/design/defaulttheme/widget/react-app && npm install && npm run build && npm run build-ie`
 * To recompile back office React APP (Left toolbar, Group Chat etc...)
   * `cd lhc_web/design/defaulttheme/js/admin &&  npm run build`
 * Recompile static JS/CSS files. This is required if you change core JS files. It also avoids missing CSS/JS files if more than one server is used.
   * `php cron.php -s site_admin -c cron/util/generate_css -p 1 && gulp js-static`
 * ORM - https://doc.livehelperchat.com/docs/development/orm
 * Common classes - https://doc.livehelperchat.com/docs/development/common-classes
 * To recompile everything at once
   * `cd lhc_web/ && ./deploy.sh`

## Features

A few main features:

 * [Bot](https://doc.livehelperchat.com/docs/how-to-use-bot) with the possibility to integrate any third-party AI
 * Tens of thousands chats per day support using [ElasticSearch](https://github.com/LiveHelperChat/elasticsearch), [NodeJS](https://github.com/LiveHelperChat/NodeJS-Helper), [PHP-Resque](https://github.com/LiveHelperChat/lhc-php-resque) System is highly optimised and battle tested for high load environment
 * XMPP support for notifications about new chats (iPhone, iPad, Android, Blackberry, GTalk, etc.)
 * Chrome extension
 * Repeatable sound notifications
 * Work hours
 * See what the user sees with a screenshot feature
 * Drag & Drop widgets, minimize/maximize widgets
 * Multiple chats at the same time
 * See what users are typing before they send a message
 * Multiple operators
 * Send delayed canned messages as if it was a real user typing
 * Chats archive
 * Priority queue
 * [Chats statistic generation](https://doc.livehelperchat.com/docs/chat/statistic)
 * Advanced agents performance tracking
 * Resume chat after the user closed the chat
 * All chats in a single window with tabs interface; tabs are remembered before they are closed
 * Chat transcript print
 * Chat transcript send by mail
 * Site widget
 * Page embed mode for live support script or widget mode, or standard mode
 * Multilanguage
 * Chats transferring
 * Departments
 * Files upload
 * Chat search
 * Automatic transfers between departments
 * Option to generate JS for different departments
 * Option to prefill form fields. 
 * Option to add custom form fields, which can be either user variables or hidden fields. Useful if you are integrating with a third-party system and want to pass user_id, for example.
 * Cronjobs
 * Callbacks
 * Closed chat callback
 * Unanswered chat callback
 * Asynchronous status loading, not blocking site javascript.
 * XML, JSON export module
 * Option to send transcript to users e-mail
 * SMTP support
 * HTTPS support
 * No third parties cookies dependency
 * Previous users chats
 * Online users tracking, including geo detection
 * GEO detection using three different sources
 * Option to configure start chat fields
 * Sounds on pending chats and new messages
 * Google chrome notifications on pending messages.
 * Browser title blinking then there is pending message.
 * Option to limit pro active chat invitation messages based on pending chats.
 * Option to configure frequency for pro active chat invitation message. You can set after how many hours for the same user invitation message should be shown again.
 * Users blocking
 * Top performance with enabled cache
 * Windows, Linux and Mac native applications.
 * Advanced embed code generation with numerous options of includable code.
 * Template override system
 * Module override system
 * Support for custom extensions
 * Changeable footer and header content
 * Option to send messges to anonymous site visitors,
 * Canned messages
 * Informing then operator or user is typing.
 * Option to see what user is typing before they send a message
 * Canned messages for desktop client
 * Voting module
 * FAQ module
 * Online users map
 * Pro active chat invitatio
 * Remember me functionality
 * Total pageviews tracking
 * Total pageviews including previous visits tracking
 * Visits tracking, how many times user has been on your page.
 * Time spent on site
 * Auto responder
 * BB Code support. Links recognition. Smiles and few other hidden features :)
 * First user visit tracking
 * Option for customers mute sounds 
 * Option for operators mute messages sounds and new pending chat's sound.
 * Option to monitor online operators.
 * Option to have different pro active messages for different domains. This can be archieved using different identifiers.
 * Dekstop client supports HTTPS
 * Protection against spammers using advanced captcha technique without requiring users to enter any captcha code.
 * Option for operator set online or offline mode.
 * Automatic chat closing
 * Distribution of visitors to different operators depending on their GEO / language (two different clients in different languages are contacting. It is possible to configure the distribution so that a Lithuanian-speaking client gets to a Lithuanian-speaking operator, and an English-speaking client to an English-speaking operator)
 * Custom distribution of visitors based on their attributes.
 * Subjects/Topics for chat
 * Desktop client for
  * Windows
  * Linux 
  * Mac
 * Flexible permission system:
  * Roles
  * Groups
  * Users



Forum:
http://forum.livehelperchat.com/

# README.md

Source: https://github.com/livehelperchat/livehelperchat/blob/master/lhc_web/doc/node_servers/cobrowsing/README.md

## Install

```
yum install nodejs npm
npm install socket.io
npm install forever
```

You may need to symlink forever to /user/bin/forever

```shell script
adduser nodejs
vim /usr/lib/systemd/system/nodejscobrowse.service
```

Service file example

```
[Unit]
Description=Live helper Chat NodeJs Co-Browsing server

[Service]
User=nodejs
ExecStart=/usr/bin/forever /var/www/client/lhc_web/doc/node_servers/cobrowsing/server.js
LimitNOFILE=100000

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

You may want to edit settings.js file if you want to run it on just for testing purposes.

## Live Helper chat changes

In Live Helper Chat if you are using `/wsnodejs/` in your nginx config.

Go to `Settings -> Live help confgiuration -> Chat configuration -> (Screen sharing)` and

* Check NodeJs support enabled
* In socket.io path enter `/wsnodejs/socket.io`

Location of `Location of SocketIO JS library` should be

https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/socket.io-client@2/dist/socket.io.js

# Live Helper Chat REST API Examples

Source: https://github.com/livehelperchat/livehelperchat/blob/master/lhc_web/doc/rest_api/readme.md

# Live Helper Chat REST API Examples

This folder contains example scripts and utilities for interacting with the Live Helper Chat REST API. Below is a description of each file and its purpose.

---

## Core Files

### `lhrestapi.php`
**REST API Client Class** — The foundational class (`LHCRestAPI`) used by all example scripts. Handles HTTP requests to the LHC REST API using cURL with HTTP Basic Authentication. Supports GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE methods, URL parameters (unordered params), and JSON or XML response parsing.

**Dependencies:** None (standalone, requires cURL and PHP `json` extension)

**Usage:**
```php
$api = new LHCRestAPI($host, $username, $apiKey);
$response = $api->execute('chats', ['status' => 1], [], 'GET', true);
```

### `settings.ini.php`
**Configuration Template** — Returns an associative array with connection settings (`host`, `user`, `key`). Used by `live_example.php`, `live_workflow.php`, and other scripts to centralize API credentials.

---

## Example & Demonstration Scripts

### `example.php`
**Basic API Examples** — Demonstrates several common REST API calls with inline credentials:
- `setoperatorstatus` — Set operator online/offline
- `chats` — List chats with filters (status, department, user)
- `departaments` — List departments
- `fetchchat` — Fetch a single chat by ID
- `fetchchatmessages` — Fetch messages for a chat (supports `last_message_id` for pagination)
- XML response format example

### `live_example.php`
**Live API Examples (with settings.ini)** — Same operations as `example.php` but reads credentials from `settings.ini.php` and includes additional filter examples:
- `filtergt` — Greater-than filtering (e.g., `id > 1000`)
- `limit`/`offset` — Pagination
- `update_activity` — Force last activity update
- `setoperatorstatus` with `user_id`

### `live_example_offline.php`
**Visibility Status Example** — Demonstrates how to set an operator's visibility (online/offline) using `setvisibilitystatus`. Can identify the user by `user_id`, `username`, or `email`.

### `live_workflow.php`
**Complete Chat Workflow** — The most comprehensive example, illustrating a full visitor chat lifecycle:

1. **Initialization** — `chatcheckoperatormessage` with page view tracking (optional `vid`, `count_page`, visitor attributes)
2. **Start Chat** — `startchat` with visitor details (Email, Department, Username, Question, TOS, Phone). Supports `proactive` mode for invitation-based chats. Optionally links to a `vid`.
3. **Check Chat Status** — `checkchatstatus` polls until the chat is activated (operator assigned). Returns `activated`, `status`, `name_support`, `closed` flags.
4. **Fetch Messages** — `fetchchatmessages` retrieves new messages with `last_message_id` pagination, `ignore_system_messages`, and `workflow` options.
5. **Send Message** — `addmsguser` posts a message as the visitor.
6. **Close Chat** — `closechatasvisitor` closes the chat from the visitor side (supports `eclose` flag for explicit close).
7. **Update Attributes** — `updatechatattributes` modifies chat custom attributes.

### `merge_vid.php`
**Visitor ID Merge** — Shows how to merge two visitor IDs (VIDs) using the `setnewvid` endpoint. Useful when a returning visitor needs to be re-identified under a different VID.

### `webhook.php`
**Incoming Webhook Example** — Demonstrates sending a JSON payload to an incoming webhook endpoint (`/webhooks/incoming/{identifier}`). Shows the expected payload format for chat messages including `chatId`, `computer`, `chatName`, `type`, `date`, `body`, and `sender` fields.

---

## Data Export & Utilities

### `chats_export.php` - Exporting chats
**Bulk Chat Export Script** — Incrementally exports chats using the `restapi/chats` endpoint with `id_gt` pagination. Key features:
- **JSONL output** — One JSON object per line
- **Resumable** — Tracks progress in `chats_export_progress.json` so exports can be interrupted and resumed
- **Configurable delay** — Skips recent chats (default 30 min) to avoid exporting in-progress conversations
- **Prefill fields** — Supports `prefill_fields` for enriched data (e.g., `messages_statistic`, `subject`, `department_name`)
- **Sorting** — Exports in ascending ID order (`id_asc`)

**Usage:** `php chats_export.php`

#### `chats_export_progress.json`
**Progress Tracking File** — Created and updated by `chats_export.php`. Stores `last_id` (last exported chat ID), `total_exported` (count), and `exported_at` (timestamp). Enables resume capability.

#### `chats_export.jsonl`
**Export Output Format** — JSON Lines file format (`.jsonl`) where each line is a JSON object representing one exported chat. This is the output file generated by `chats_export.php`.

### `conversations_export.php` - Exporting conversations
**Bulk Mail Conversations Export Script** — Incrementally exports mail conversations using the `restapi/conversations` endpoint with `id_gt` pagination. Key features:
- **JSONL output** — One JSON object per line
- **Resumable** — Tracks progress in `conversations_export_progress.json` so exports can be interrupted and resumed
- **Configurable delay** — Skips recent conversations via `timetots` (default 30 min)
- **Prefill fields** — Supports `prefill_fields` (e.g., `mailbox`, `mail_variables_array`)
- **Include messages** — Optionally embeds all messages within each conversation via `include_messages`
- **Sorting** — Exports in ascending ID order (`id_asc`)

**Usage:** `php conversations_export.php`

#### `conversations_export_progress.json`
**Progress Tracking File** — Created and updated by `conversations_export.php`. Stores `last_id`, `total_exported`, and `exported_at`. Enables resume capability.

#### `conversations_export.jsonl`
**Export Output Format** — JSON Lines file (`.jsonl`) where each line is a JSON object representing one exported mail conversation.

### `conversations_messages_export.php`- Exporting conversations messages directly
**Bulk Mail Messages Export Script** — Incrementally exports individual mail messages using the `restapi/conversationsmessages` endpoint with `id_gt` pagination. Key features:
- **JSONL output** — One JSON object per line (message-level, not conversation-level)
- **Resumable** — Tracks progress in `conversations_messages_export_progress.json`
- **Configurable delay** — Skips recent messages via `timetots` (default 30 min)
- **Prefill fields** — Supports `prefill_fields` (e.g., `conversation`, `department`, `mailbox`, `user`, `plain_user_name`, `files`, `attachments`, `subjects`, `body_front`, `wait_time_pending`, `wait_time_response`, etc.)
- **Include conversations** — Optionally embed parent conversation objects via `include_conversations`
- **Sorting** — Exports in ascending ID order (`id_asc`)

**Usage:** `php conversations_messages_export.php`

#### `conversations_messages_export_progress.json`
**Progress Tracking File** — Created and updated by `conversations_messages_export.php`. Stores `last_id`, `total_exported`, and `exported_at`.

#### `conversations_messages_export.jsonl`
**Export Output Format** — JSON Lines file (`.jsonl`) where each line is a JSON object representing one exported mail message.

---

## API Documentation

### `swagger.json`
**OpenAPI/Swagger Specification** — Machine-readable REST API documentation in Swagger/OpenAPI format. Can be imported into tools like Swagger UI, Postman, or Stoplight for interactive API exploration.

Online reference: https://api.livehelperchat.com/
